label: Azure Blob Storage Backup Container
description: Sends Backup Set and archive CSV files to an Azure Blob Storage container with Microsoft Entra ID (OAuth), never a shared key or SAS token. Make the connection in Setup first (an External Credential with OAuth 2.0 client credentials or a browser flow for scope https://storage.azure.com/.default, and a Named Credential named BarnConn_azureblob with the URL https://ACCOUNT.blob.core.windows.net and principal OAuth), as the admin guide's Backup Destination section describes. Give the app the Storage Blob Data Contributor role on the container only. Replace barncrm-backups in the path with the container's name.
